deelToken.description:
## Authentication
The Deel API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests. All API calls must be made over HTTPS — calls over plain HTTP or without authentication will fail.

```curl
curl -X GET 'https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2/contracts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN-HERE'
```

[Learn more about authentication](/api/authentication)

post.description:
Create a payroll adjustment for a contract to add or correct a payment amount on an upcoming payment cycle. Use this endpoint when you need to programmatically apply one-off adjustments; each adjustment must reference a valid category from `GET /rest/adjustments/categories`, which determines its type and accounting treatment.

 **Token scopes**: `adjustments:write`, `worker:write`

data.description: Details of adjustment to create

contract_id.description: The identifier of the contract associated with the adjustment

country.description: Country the expense was incurred in, which is not necessarily the contract country. Conditionally required: for adjustment categories configured to require a country, which is typically an expense category, and for Global Payroll contracts whenever the organization has the compliance check enabled, which applies to any category. Leave the field out entirely when it does not apply - sending it empty is rejected, because the pattern still applies to a value that is present.

date_of_adjustment.description: Short date in format ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). For example: 2022-12-31.

move_next_cycle.description: If an adjustments can belong to another payroll cycle.

odp_only.description: EOR contracts only. Restrict the adjustment to on-demand payroll: when true it is never attached to a regular payroll cycle, and it is automatically denied if it is still not part of an on-demand payroll 30 days after creation. Sending it for any other contract type is rejected, because on-demand payroll does not exist there. Editable only through this API, and it forces move_next_cycle to false.

submitter_profile_id.description: The identifier of the profile that submits the adjustment. Must be a profile authorized on the target contract. When omitted, the adjustment is attributed to the profile resolved from the API token.

vendor.description: Vendor of adjustment. Conditionally required: for adjustment categories configured to require a vendor, which is typically an expense category, and for Global Payroll contracts whenever the organization has the compliance check enabled, which applies to any category. Leave the field out entirely when it does not apply - sending it empty is rejected, because the length constraint still applies to a value that is present.

Retrieves the feedback a hiring panel has recorded against one application's interviews and evaluations. Use it to pull scorecards into an external reporting, analytics or compliance system, or to decide whether a candidate is ready to advance: only NOT_SUBMITTED is still outstanding, while DISMISSED and REVOKED are resolved outcomes that will never produce a submission and should not be waited on.

post.description:
Moves an application to a stage of its job's interview plan, or records a stage it already went through without changing its current stage. Use it to advance a candidate after an interview or a hiring decision; entering a stage can trigger that stage's job activities, and archiving the candidate can also send them a rejection email. Find stage ids with `GET /rest/ats/jobs/{job_id}/interview-plan-stages`.

 **Token scopes**: `ats:write`, `worker:write`

 **Beta version available**: version `2026-11-06` of this endpoint is in beta. Send `X-Beta: true` to call it.

Starts the termination of a contractor contract, either immediately or on a future date, in which case the termination stays pending until that date. get.description:
Returns the benefits for the authenticated employee. The employee identity is inferred from the auth token, so this endpoint must be called with an employee-scoped token rather than a client token.

 **Token scopes**: `benefits:read`

data.description: List of contracts with their associated benefits. An employee may have benefits across multiple contracts if they have more than one active engagement.

benefits.description: All benefits associated with this contract, regardless of enrollment status. Includes benefits the employee is enrolled in, has opted out of, or is pending enrollment for.

benefit_type_code.description: Jurisdiction-aware classification code for this benefit. Use this (not only `type`) when product logic must differ by country — for example retirement: `401_K` in the US versus `OCCUPATIONAL_PENSION` in the UK and Ireland. Other common values include HEALTHCARE, DENTAL, VISION, LIFE_INSURANCE, ACCIDENT_INSURANCE, and CRITICAL_ILLNESS; the full set may expand as new benefit types are added.

contract_type.description: Workforce product for the contract this benefit belongs to. EOR — Employer of Record; Deel is the legal employer. GP — Global Payroll; the client is the legal employer and Deel runs payroll. PEO — Professional Employer Organization (US co-employment). EMBEDDED — payroll or HR through an embedded partner integration.

coverage_group.description: Who is covered under this benefit, derived from enrolled dependents on the contract benefit. EMPLOYEE = employee only. EMPLOYEE_AND_SPOUSE = employee plus legal spouse. EMPLOYEE_AND_DOMESTIC_PARTNER = employee plus registered domestic partner where applicable. EMPLOYEE_AND_CHILD = employee plus dependent child coverage structured as a single-child tier. EMPLOYEE_AND_CHILDREN = employee plus all enrolled children. EMPLOYEE_AND_FAMILY = employee plus spouse or partner and children (full family tier) per plan rules.

description.description: Plain-text explanation of what this benefit covers and why it matters to the employee. Suitable for display in a benefits overview UI or summary card.
description.example: Ensure the employee is covered by a healthcare option.

effective_date.description: Date from which this benefit offering is in effect for this employee in this response (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). The benefit offering's offered-at date when present — not the same as contract coverage start or plan-specific coverage start dates inside enrollment.

employee_contribution.description: Recurring portion of plan cost collected from the employee's pay for this benefit. Expressed with calculation metadata (`type`, `value`), resolved `amount`, `currency`, and `frequency`. For a given period, `employee_contribution.amount` plus `employer_contribution.amount` reflects the split of premium or plan cost represented here; use `enrollment_details` cycle fields when you need billed totals for the current cycle.

amount.description: Resolved employee contribution in `currency` for each `frequency` period (for example `100` with `USD` and `MONTHLY` means one hundred US dollars per month).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `amount` (for example USD, CAD, GBP). Matches the parent contract's `currency` for this benefits payload.

frequency.description: Payroll or billing cadence for this contribution. Typical values include MONTHLY, SEMI_MONTHLY (twice per month), BIWEEKLY, WEEKLY, and ANNUALLY; exact strings follow Deel payroll configuration.

type.description: How the employee contribution is derived. FIXED_AMOUNT = flat currency per `frequency`. PERCENTAGE = percent of an earnings or cost basis defined by the plan. Additional values (for example employer match shapes on retirement benefits) can appear for specialized products.

value.description: Raw contribution input from configuration or upstream systems; may be a number or string (for example `"1.23"`). Use `amount` for display and arithmetic — it is the normalized numeric value in `currency` per `frequency`.

employer_contribution.description: Recurring employer-paid portion for this benefit, same shape as `employee_contribution`. Together with `employee_contribution.amount`, describes how premium or plan cost is split for the modeled period; billed totals for the active cycle may also appear under `enrollment_details`.

amount.description: Resolved employer contribution in `currency` per `frequency` period.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `amount`. Matches the parent contract's `currency`.

frequency.description: Cadence at which the employer contribution is applied. Same vocabulary as `employee_contribution.frequency`.

type.description: How the employer contribution is derived. FIXED_AMOUNT = flat currency per `frequency`. PERCENTAGE = percent of an earnings or cost basis. Additional values may appear for specialized products.

value.description: Raw employer contribution input; may be number or string depending on source. Prefer `amount` for calculations and UI.

end_date.description: Date on which this benefit's coverage ends (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Benefit record's effective end, termination, or offer end where applicable. Null or absent when no definitive end date is set on this record (coverage may still change if the contract or offering is updated).

enrollment_details.description: Details about the specific plan and provider the employee is currently enrolled in, along with the cost breakdown for the current billing cycle. Reflects the employee's actual enrollment, which may differ from organization_selection if the employee made their own plan choice.

current_cycle_employer_contribution.description: Amount the employer contributes toward the plan cost for the current billing cycle, in the contract's currency. This is the portion the company pays on the employee's behalf. The employee's actual cost is current_cycle_plan_cost minus this value. Null when no contribution has been calculated for the current cycle yet.

current_cycle_plan_cost.description: Total cost of the selected plan for the current billing cycle, in the contract's currency. This is the gross plan cost before employer contributions are applied. Subtract current_cycle_employer_contribution to get the employee's net out-of-pocket cost. Null when no cost has been calculated for the current cycle yet.

selected_plan.description: The specific benefit plan the employee is enrolled in (e.g. 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze'). Contains the plan's ID, display name, and downloadable plan documents.

attachments.description: Downloadable documents associated with this plan (e.g. Summary of Benefits and Coverage, Certificate of Coverage, plan brochure). Render each item as a labeled download link.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attachment document.

label.description: Human-readable filename or label for the attachment (e.g. 'Canada_Benefits.pdf'). Use as the visible text for download links.

url.description: Direct URL to download or view the attachment. Typically a PDF. Use as the href for a download link.

id.description: Unique identifier for this benefit plan. Use when referencing the plan in enrollment or amendment API calls.

name.description: Display name of the plan tier (e.g. 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze'). Shown to employees during enrollment selection and in benefits summaries.

selected_provider.description: The insurance carrier or benefit administrator managing the employee's currently enrolled plan. Includes portal access URL and provider-level documents.

attachments.description: Provider-level documents such as general coverage guides, network directories, or enrollment guides. Render each as a labeled download link.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attachment document.

label.description: Human-readable filename or label for the attachment. Use as the visible text for download links.

url.description: Direct URL to download or view the attachment. Use as the href for a download link.

home_page_url.description: URL to the employee-facing provider portal where the employee can view claims, access ID cards, find in-network providers, and manage coverage details.

is_unisure.description: True if this benefit is administered through Unisure, a global group insurance platform Deel uses to deliver international EOR benefits. Relevant for understanding the benefit's administration model and claims process.

name.description: Display name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider (e.g. 'ManuLife', 'Aetna'). Use for labeling in UI.

enrollment_status.description: Enrollment lifecycle state for this benefit. Always matches `status` in this API version; both are returned so integrations can use the explicit `enrollment_status` name. PENDING = benefit exists but no enrollment action yet. AWAITING_ENROLLMENT = employee must complete enrollment while an enrollment window applies. AWAITING_CARRIER_CONFIRMATION = submission received; awaiting carrier or administrator confirmation. AWAITING_CONTRACT_ACTIVATION = enrollment cannot complete until the underlying employment contract is active. AWAITING_EMPLOYEE = the benefit is offered but paused; the employee does not contribute yet, so there is no deduction and no admin fee. ENROLLED = active coverage. OPTED_OUT = employee stopped or waived the coverage. TERMINATED = stopped before natural expiry. EXPIRED = coverage window has ended.

enrollment_window.description: Calendar window during which the employee may enroll in, change, or opt out of this benefit. Omitted when no window is returned (enrollment changes are then not accepted until a new window opens, for example open enrollment, a qualifying life event, or a new-hire cycle per employer configuration).

ends_at.description: Last date the enrollment window is open (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). After this date, enrollment is locked until a new window is triggered.

starts_at.description: First date the enrollment window is open (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Enrollment actions are accepted on or after this date only.

trigger.description: Business reason this window was opened. new_hire = initial enrollment after onboarding completes. open_enrollment = scheduled annual election period. qualifying_life_event = permitted mid-year change after a life event (for example marriage, birth, divorce) per plan rules. termination = window tied to offboarding, often for continuation or COBRA-style elections in applicable jurisdictions.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this benefit instance. Use this when referencing the benefit in subsequent API calls.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the benefit (e.g. 'Healthcare', 'Dental', '401(k)'). Suitable for display in UI.

organization_selection.description: The plan and provider the client organization has configured as the default offering for this benefit type. This reflects the employer's choice, which may differ from enrollment_details if the employee hasn't enrolled yet or selected a different option during open enrollment.

selected_plan.description: The plan tier the organization has chosen to offer employees by default for this benefit.

attachments.description: Downloadable plan documents for the organization's selected plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attachment document.

url.description: Direct URL to download or view the attachment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the organization's selected plan.

name.description: Display name of the plan tier the organization has selected (e.g. 'Gold', 'Silver'). Shown to employees as the employer-offered default.

selected_provider.description: The insurance carrier or benefit provider the organization has contracted with to administer this benefit.

attachments.description: Provider-level documents associated with the organization's selected provider.

plan_url.description: URL to this specific plan's portal or documentation — for example, a plan summary PDF, carrier-hosted plan detail page, or plan materials. Distinct from `provider_website_url` (the provider organization as a whole) and `home_page_url` (employee portal for claims and ID cards).

provider_name.description: Display name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider administering this plan (for example Allianz, Cigna, ManuLife).

provider_website_url.description: Public marketing or corporate website for the carrier or administrator. For the employee-facing portal (claims, ID cards, provider search), use `home_page_url` when enrolled.

status.description: Enrollment lifecycle state for this benefit. Populated with the same value as `enrollment_status` (both fields are returned for backward compatibility). ENROLLED = active, claimable coverage. OPTED_OUT = employee stopped or waived the coverage. TERMINATED = cancelled mid-contract. EXPIRED = coverage period ended. PENDING, AWAITING_ENROLLMENT, AWAITING_CARRIER_CONFIRMATION, AWAITING_CONTRACT_ACTIVATION, and AWAITING_EMPLOYEE indicate transitional or pre-active states (AWAITING_EMPLOYEE: the benefit is offered but paused; the employee does not contribute yet, so there is no deduction and no admin fee); see `enrollment_status` for the same enumeration and definitions.

type.description: High-level category of the benefit (e.g. HEALTHCARE, DENTAL, VISION). May be null if uncategorized. Use benefit_type_code for a more specific, jurisdiction-aware value.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for the employment contract these benefits are associated with. Use to correlate benefits with a specific contract when the employee has multiple active engagements.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts within this contract's benefits (e.g. 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'). Applies to all cost and contribution fields in this contract grouping.

Retrieves the country-specific additional fields a Global Payroll worker must provide to stay compliant with local regulations. Call this before creating a GP contract or submitting worker additional information via POST or PATCH `/gp/workers/contracts/{contract_id}/additional-information`, so you know which fields to include and whether each is required.

 **Token scopes**: `forms:read`

parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for which to retrieve GP worker additional fields.
parameters.name: country_code

ui_guide.helper_text: Select the worker's current marital status
ui_guide.label: Marital Status

data.description: Use this array to build the form UI. Each item defines one field with its type, validation, and display configuration. Items are pre-sorted by EDM display order. An empty array means no additional fields are configured for the requested country.

dependencies.description: Use this array to implement conditional field visibility. When non-empty, this field should only be displayed and required when the referenced dependency conditions are met. An empty array means the field has no conditional dependencies.

key.description: Use this value to identify the field that this dependency refers to. Contains the snake_case key of the dependency field, matching another field's 'key' property in the same response.

value.description: Use this value to evaluate the dependency condition. When the value is a primitive (string, number, or boolean), the condition is satisfied when the referenced field equals this value. When the value is an array, the condition is satisfied when the referenced field equals any one of its entries. When the value is an object, apply the operator in 'op': 'eq' (equals), 'ne' (not equals), 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal), 'contains' (field value contains the specified substring) each compare against 'value', while 'notnull' takes no operand and is satisfied when the referenced field holds any non-empty value.

op.description: Use this operator to evaluate the dependency condition against the referenced field's submitted value.

value.description: Use this value as the operand for the dependency condition evaluation.

op.description: Use this operator on its own: the condition is satisfied when the referenced field holds any non-empty value. It takes no operand.

oneOf.description: Use this list as the set of acceptable values: the condition is satisfied when the referenced field equals any one of them.

is_required.description: Use this flag to determine whether the field must be provided when submitting additional information. For GP workers, the value considers the GP-specific optionality setting when available, falling back to the general optionality flag.

key.description: Use this value as the field identifier when submitting additional information. Represents the snake_case version of the internal field name, generated by the API naming convention service.

required_by.description: Use this value to determine at which stage in the payroll lifecycle this field must be collected. Known values: 'before_payroll' (required before payroll processing), 'after_payroll' (can be collected after initial payroll), 'contract_signing' (required at contract signing). Absent from the response when no lifecycle stage is configured.

type.description: Use this value to determine the data type expected when submitting field values. Mapped from the raw input type: 'date', 'text', 'select', 'textarea', 'tel', 'phone', and 'string' map to "string"; 'number' maps to "number"; 'checkbox' maps to "boolean". An empty string indicates an unrecognized input type.

ui_guide.description: Use this object to control how the field is rendered in the UI. Contains labels, input type, display order, and supplementary text.

description.description: Use this value to display supplementary context about the field below or beside the input. HTML tags are stripped. Returns an empty string when no description is configured.

field_type.description: Use this value to select the appropriate UI input component. Represents the raw input type from the field configuration. Known values include 'text', 'date', 'select', 'textarea', 'tel', 'phone', 'number', 'checkbox', and 'string'. Additional values may exist.

helper_text.description: Use this value to display footnote or instructional text near the field. HTML tags are stripped. Returns an empty string when no helper text is configured.

label.description: Use this value as the primary English-language label when rendering the field in the UI.

local_label.description: Use this value as the localized field label when rendering the form in the worker's local language.

order.description: Use this value to determine the display position of the field in the form. Starts at 1 and reflects the position in the response array, which is pre-sorted by the configured display order.

validation.description: Use this array to apply client-side validation before form submission. Contains zero or one validation rule per field. An empty array means no validation is configured.

error_message.description: Use this message to display to the user when the field value fails validation. Defaults to 'Review the value entered' when no custom message is configured.

type.description: Use this value to determine which validation strategy to apply. "REGEX" indicates the 'value' field contains a regular expression pattern. Any other value indicates a custom validation type identified by its uppercase name.

value.description: Use this value as the validation parameter. For REGEX type, contains the regular expression pattern to validate the field input against. Absent when the validation type is a custom type that does not require a parameter.

values_allowed.description: Use this array to populate dropdown or select options when field_type is 'select'. Only present when the field has predefined options. Absent from the response for free-text, date, number, and other non-select field types.

patch.description:
Use this endpoint to correct or change country-specific additional information already held on a Global Payroll worker contract, for example after the worker reports a new marital status or a tax identifier changes. Only the fields sent under `data` are modified; everything else is left untouched. Field keys must belong to the additional-information fields defined for the contract country (see `GET /rest/forms/gp/worker-additional-fields/{country_code}`). For fields the organization has configured as effective-dated, a date must be supplied in `effective_dates` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) whenever the value changes: today or a past date applies the change immediately, a future date schedules it and the current value stays in effect until then. Unchanged values and clears need no date. Changes are recorded in the contract history and may update the worker onboarding checklist. By default returns 204. Pass `?include_completion_status=true` to receive a 200 response with `is_additional_data_done` (true when all required fields for EDM onboarding are provided) and `missing_keys` (required fields still absent). Requires the `people:write` scope.

 **Token scopes**: `people:write`

parameters.description: The unique public identifier of the contract.
parameters.name: contract_id

parameters.description: Pass `true` to receive a 200 response with `is_additional_data_done` and `missing_keys` instead of the default 204 No Content.
parameters.name: include_completion_status

effective_dates.description: Per-field effective date (YYYY-MM-DD), keyed like `data`. Only allowed for effective-dated fields, and required whenever such a field is set to a new value (unchanged values and clears need no date). Past dates apply immediately as corrections, future dates are scheduled.

is_additional_data_done.description: True when all required additional information fields for EDM onboarding have been provided.

is_updated.description: Indicates if the contract was updated.

missing_keys.description: Public API keys of required fields still missing. Empty when is_additional_data_done is true.

200.description: Returned only when `?include_completion_status=true` is passed. Contains completion status.

204.description: Successful update. No body returned (default when `include_completion_status` is absent or false).

patch.description:
Updates the detail fields of an asset owned by the calling organization. Only the fields present in the request body are changed; a field the caller omits keeps its current value, so there is no way to clear a field back to empty. Changing `serial_number` unenrolls the asset from MDM device management. Assets whose detail fields are locked — archived or Deel-owned assets, or assets covered by an active service package — are rejected.

 **Token scopes**: `it-assets:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2026-12-29.

post.description:
Use this to add a Deel IT service, such as device lifecycle management, to an asset your organization already tracks in Deel IT, for example right after registering it from your MDM, inventory or procurement tool, so the device is covered without enrolling it manually in the Deel IT UI. Send the `bundle` of an addon listed without a `fail_reason` under `actions.assign_addon_to_own_asset.details.addons[]` on `GET /rest/it/assets/{asset_id}`. The service starts on the day of the call and is billed under your organization's addon terms.

 **Token scopes**: `it-assets:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2027-02-11.

post.description:
Archives an IT asset that has left active use, so an external inventory or MDM/CMDB tool can keep Deel IT in sync. Archiving also removes the asset's host record, if any, and ends any contract add-ons it carries. To restore an archived asset, use `POST /rest/it/assets/{asset_id}/unarchive`; it brings back the asset's active status and location, but not the host or the add-ons.

post.description:
Recovers a device from a worker at offboarding, or to send it on for reuse, repair, or clearance. Picks a customer-owned asset up from its current location and routes it to a warehouse or a Deel-managed reuse location. Exactly one of `warehouse_id` or `store_and_reuse_location` must be supplied.

 **Token scopes**: `it-service-requests:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2026-12-15.

country.description: Country the asset is being picked up from. Overrides the country the asset-action validator derives from asset state.

not_before.description: Earliest date Deel logistics may execute the pickup.

shipment_insurance.description: Insurance-consent flag and optional purchase details Deel records against the asset. May be omitted (or sent with `is_waived: false` and no `purchase_details`) if the asset already has a purchase price and date on record. Ignored for an asset bought from Deel, which always ships insured with its stored details unchanged.

is_waived.description: Consent to ship without insurance. When true, `purchase_details` must be omitted and Deel will not record a purchase price against the asset. Ignored for an asset bought from Deel.

purchase_details.description: Purchase details Deel records against the asset. Omit to fall back to purchase details already stored on the asset, if any. Must be omitted when `is_waived` is true. Ignored for an asset bought from Deel.

price.description: Purchase price paid for the asset.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

store_and_reuse_location.description: Deel-managed reuse destination for the collection. Mutually exclusive with `warehouse_id`.

post.summary: Create a collection for an IT asset

post.description:
Create a delivery request to ship an asset from a warehouse to a worker (HRIS profile), with Deel operations executing the logistics. If you only need to record a location change without using Deel IT services, use `POST /rest/it/assets/{asset_id}/location`. Calling it accepts the asset's current condition; see `inspection` on the asset response.

 **Token scopes**: `it-service-requests:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2026-12-15.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the IT asset
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.description: Opts in to the beta version of this endpoint. Must be `true`.
parameters.name: X-Beta

delivery_address.description: Delivery address for the recipient. Optional when the HRIS profile already has a valid delivery address on file.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth

passport_number.description: Passport number

tax_id_number.description: Tax ID number

hris_profile_id.description: HRIS profile identifier of the recipient.

is_express_delivery.description: Whether express delivery is requested. Defaults to false. Charges an express fee where the country supports express delivery.

shipment_insurance.description: Insurance-consent flag and optional purchase details Deel records against the asset. Required for every asset uploaded by the organization, including one already at a Deel warehouse: send either purchase details or a waiver. With `is_waived` false, purchase details may be left out only if the asset already has a purchase price and date on record. Optional and ignored for an asset bought from Deel, which always ships insured with its stored details unchanged.

is_waived.description: Consent to ship without insurance. When true, `purchase_details` must be omitted and Deel will not record a purchase price against the asset. Ignored for an asset bought from Deel.

purchase_details.description: Purchase details Deel records against the asset. Omit to fall back to purchase details already stored on the asset, if any. Must be omitted when `is_waived` is true. Ignored for an asset bought from Deel.

price.description: Purchase price paid for the asset.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

requestBody.description: Delivery details

actions.description: Actions the caller can execute on this asset, with availability status per action

allowed_statuses.description: Statuses that can be passed as the archive reason when archiving the asset

assignment delivery country. Null when the country cannot be determined
(e.g. asset was returned to Deel)

post.summary: Create a delivery request for an IT asset

post.description:
Records that the asset moved to a new location without triggering Deel logistics or invoicing. Use this to reflect a self-serve transfer between HRIS profiles (target `location = WITH_USER` with a different `hris_profile_id`), a delivery from your organization storage location to a worker (from `AT_WAREHOUSE` to `WITH_USER`), or a collection from a worker back to your storage location (from `WITH_USER` to `AT_WAREHOUSE`).

 **Token scopes**: `it-assets:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2026-12-15.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the IT asset
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.description: Opts in to the beta version of this endpoint. Must be `true`.
parameters.name: X-Beta

hris_profile_id.description:
HRIS profile ID of the user the asset is being moved to. Required when
location is WITH_USER; ignored when location is AT_WAREHOUSE.

location.description:
Target location for the asset. Only WITH_USER and AT_WAREHOUSE are
accepted; other ItemLocation values are managed by Deel logistics and
rejected with 400. Supported values that produce a transition the
underlying self-serve workflow cannot perform (e.g. AT_WAREHOUSE ->
AT_WAREHOUSE) are rejected with 409 by the workflow's own asset_not_*
errors.

warehouse_id.description:
ID of the organization storage location the asset is being moved to.
Required when location is AT_WAREHOUSE; ignored when location is WITH_USER.

get.description:
Returns the Know Your Business (entity verification) state of a legal entity: the verification status, whether the client must act, the outstanding requirements including Proof of Authority, which company documents have been supplied, the declared persons of significant control, when the entity was rejected, and the open enhanced due diligence (EDD) request with its questions while the entity is in EDD. Use it to drive an automated verification flow instead of finishing KYB in the Deel app.

 **Token scopes**: `legal-entity:read`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2027-01-01.

parameters.description: Public id of the legal entity. The entity must belong to the authenticated organization; any other id answers 404.
parameters.name: legal_entity_id

parameters.description: Opts in to the beta version of this endpoint. Must be `true`.
parameters.name: X-Beta

approved.description: The verification passed. The entity is `active` and nothing is outstanding.

edd.description: Deel needs more answers before it continues the review. Answer with `POST /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/kyb/edd`. Question `q2` applies only when `q1` is answered `Yes`.

questions.title: Does the company receive funds from outside its country of incorporation?
Upload a contract with your largest foreign customer.
Describe the company's main business activity.
What is the expected yearly turnover in EUR?
Which period do the financial statements cover?
What is the registered address of your largest foreign customer?

not_submitted.description: A new entity with full verification. Every requirement is outstanding and nothing has been declared or uploaded.

rejected.description: The verification was rejected. `status` stays `pending_verification` and `is_action_required` is `false`, because the client cannot act: `POST /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/kyb` refuses a rejected entity (`KYB_ENTITY_REJECTED`) and resubmission is not yet supported over the API. `rejection` is only present after a rejection and repeats `rejected_at`. The reason is not part of this response.

submitted.description: The state right after the "Submitter acts with a Proof of Authority" request example was accepted. Every requirement is met, and the Proof of Authority is listed in `documents` with its `meta_type`.

approved_at.description: When the entity was approved; null otherwise.

documents.description: Presence of every company-level document type. Null when `is_detail_available` is false.

is_provided.description: Whether a file for this document has been submitted. File contents and URLs are never returned.

is_required.description: Whether the verification service currently requires this document.

meta_type.description: Kind of Proof of Authority document, when this entry's type is PROOF_OF_AUTHORITY. Null for every other document type.

edd.description: The open enhanced due diligence (EDD) request while the entity is in EDD: Deel needs further answers from the client before it continues the review. Null otherwise, and null while the entity is in EDD when the questions could not be read (retry later).

id.description: Public id of the EDD request. Send it as `edd_request_id` when answering.

is_answerable_over_api.description: False when the form has a required unsupported question. Contact Deel support to clear such a request.

questions.description: Every question of the EDD form, in form order.

description.description: Helper text for the question, when any.
description.example: For example revenue from customers, investment, or a loan.

is_required.description: Whether the question must currently be answered.

key.description: Key of the question within this EDD request, in form order. Send it as `question_key` when answering.

options.description: For `SINGLE_CHOICE` and `MULTIPLE_CHOICE` questions, the option titles to answer with. Null for every other type.

repeat_group.description: Set when this question belongs to a repeatable group (e.g. "add another director"); null otherwise.

index.description: Zero-based position of this question within its repeat group instance.

max_repeats.description: Maximum number of instances of this group the form allows.

name.description: Name of the repeatable group this question belongs to.

revealed_when.description: Conditions under which this question applies, met if any one of them does. Null when the question always applies. Only answer it when a condition is met.

equals.description: Option title `question` must be answered with for this question to apply.

question.description: Key of the question whose answer gates this one.

title.description: The question as the reviewer wrote it.
title.example: What is the source of the funds used to pay Deel invoices?

type.description: What kind of answer the question takes. `COUNTRY` takes an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `US`), `CURRENCY` an ISO 4217 code (e.g. `USD`) and `STATE` a state name (e.g. `California`), each as a string, or a list of strings when the form allows several. `DOCUMENT_UPLOAD` questions are answered with a list of document handles from `POST /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/kyb/edd/documents`. `UNSUPPORTED` questions cannot be answered over the API; when one of them is required, `is_answerable_over_api` is false.

status.description: `AWAITING_ANSWERS` until the answers are sent; `ANSWERED` once they are, until the entity is back in review.

is_action_required.description: True while the entity is waiting on the client: `PENDING`, `DRAFT`, or `EDD` (enhanced due diligence — Ops needs something further from the client). False while Deel is reviewing or once the entity is approved, rejected or exempt.

is_detail_available.description: False when the verification service could not be read. Every detail block (`requirements`, `documents`, `persons`, `rejection`, `edd`) is then null. Retry later; the status fields are still authoritative.

legal_entity_id.description: Public id of the legal entity.

persons.description: Declared persons of significant control: directors, controlling officers, owners and the submitter. Dates of birth, tax ids, addresses and identity documents are never returned; the person requirements in `requirements` show whether they were provided. Null when `is_detail_available` is false.

id.description: Public id of the declared person, when the verification service has assigned one.

ownership_percentage.description: Declared ownership percentage for owners; null otherwise.

post.description:
Submits the Know Your Business (entity verification) information for a legal entity — company facts, required declarations, documents, declared persons of significant control, and the industry questionnaire when one applies. Only accepted while the entity is `PENDING` or `DRAFT`; refused once it is `REJECTED`, already under review, approved, or when verification isn't required. Returns the resulting KYB state after submission.

 **Token scopes**: `legal-entity:write`

Add multiple admins to child organizations in one call (e.g., when a new team member joins). Provide the admins and target child organizations: people who are not members yet are invited by email, and existing members are made admins. People who are already admins are left unchanged and get no new invitation. The response shows results for each admin-organization pair.

 **Token scopes**: `organizations:write`

ALREADY_ADMIN means the person already was, and nothing changed or was sent. FAILED means the pair could not be processed; the other pairs are unaffected and the same request can be retried.

post.description:
Remove multiple admins from child organizations in one call (e.g., when someone leaves). Provide the admins and target child organizations—admins lose all access to those organizations, not only the admin role. Each child organization must keep at least one admin. If your request would remove all admins, the last one stays with status LAST_ADMIN. The response shows results for each admin-organization pair.

 **Token scopes**: `organizations:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2027-02-13.

Every id must be a direct child organization of the authenticated organization. The number of admins multiplied by the number of child organizations must not exceed 100.

REMOVED means the person lost their team and entity roles and no longer belongs to the child organization; their Deel login and their other organizations are untouched. LAST_ADMIN means removing the person would leave the child organization without an admin: when a request names every admin of a child organization, the last of them in the request is kept with their roles unchanged. FAILED means the pair could not be processed and nothing changed for it; the other pairs are unaffected.

post.description:
Creates a payment statement for the requested invoices and pays it in a single call, instead of creating and paying in two separate steps. The statement is paid by bank transfer unless payment.method names another push method, such as a stablecoin transfer. Use it when all invoices belong in one statement, grouped by statement type and legal entity. Every invoice must also be pending and not already locked in another payment. Submit invoices that span more than one statement in separate calls.

 **Token scopes**: `payment-statements:write`

parameters.description: Unique key that makes the request idempotent. Replaying the same key returns the original response without creating a duplicate statement. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

invoice_ids.description: Identifiers of the invoices to include in the payment statement. A maximum of 100 invoices can be paid in one request.

payment.description: Settlement details for the payment: the push method and the currency, plus the country for a bank transfer (also when method is omitted) or the network for a stablecoin transfer.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the bank transfer method, following ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required when method is BANK_TRANSFER or omitted (bank transfer is the default); ignored for STABLECOIN_TRANSFER.

currency.description: Currency to pay in: a three-letter ISO 4217 code for a bank transfer, or USDC or USDT for a stablecoin transfer. Must match the currency of the created statement.

method.description: Push method to pay the statement with. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER. STABLECOIN_TRANSFER pays in USDC or USDT to a deposit address Deel returns for the organization, currency and network; it must be enabled for the organization.

network.description: Blockchain network to send the stablecoin on. Required for STABLECOIN_TRANSFER and not accepted for other methods. USDC runs on ETHEREUM, BASE, SOLANA and POLYGON; USDT on TRON, ETHEREUM and POLYGON.

requestBody.description: Invoices and settlement options for the payment statement.

amount.description: Total amount of the payment statement before any balance is applied. Null until the amount is set.

amount_due.description: Amount still due after any applied balance and fee credits. Null until the amount is set.

balance_applied.description: Amount of client balance applied to the payment statement.

beneficiary_details.description: Where to send the payment: the bank account for bank transfers and Mercury, the deposit address for stablecoin, or the account email for Coinbase and Wise. Null when not yet resolved.

account_holder.description: Name of the beneficiary account holder. Null when not modeled on the rail.

account_number.description: Beneficiary account number. Null on IBAN-only rails.

account_type.description: Type of the beneficiary account. Null when not applicable.

ach_routing_number.description: Routing number to use for ACH transfers. Null when not applicable.

address.description: Address to include on the transfer for this rail. Null when not applicable.
address.example: 100 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States

bank_address.description: Address of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.
bank_address.example: 200 King Street West, Toronto, ON M5H 3T4, Canada

bank_code.description: Local bank code or institution number of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

branch_code.description: Branch code or transit number of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

Map of calendar milestone keys to their scheduled date-time values. A calendar holds only the milestones its payroll uses. Possible keys:
- `START`: Start date of the payroll cycle.
- `END`: End date of the payroll cycle.
- `CYCLE_SUBMISSION`: Deadline to submit payroll inputs for the cycle.
- `CYCLE_PUBLISHING`: Date the processed payroll is published for review.
- `CYCLE_APPROVAL`: Deadline to approve the payroll (for EOR, the payments package).
- `PAYROLL_FUNDING`: Date the payroll funding invoice is issued.
- `FUNDING_PAYMENT_RECEIPT`: Date the funding payment must be received.

patch.description:
Partially updates up to 100 shifts of one Global Payroll contract (`contract_id`); omitted fields are left unchanged. Each shift follows the single-shift update rules: correction and raw shifts, shifts in a closed payroll cycle, and a change to a shift rate of another type are rejected. All or nothing: if any shift fails, none is updated and every failure is listed.

 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

 **Beta**: this version requires the `X-Beta: true` request header and its contract may change before it is promoted to stable. It is scheduled to become stable on 2027-02-10.

Mutually exclusive with `time_amount`/`time_unit` — do not send both groups.

time_amount.description: The amount of time for the shift. Mutually exclusive with `shift_duration_hours`/`total_break_hours`/`payable_break_hours`/`total_payable_hours` — do not send both groups.

post.description:
Creates categorised shifts, each with a shift type and rate, for a Global Payroll contract, including corrections to shifts already exported to payroll. Shifts are saved first and exported to payroll in the background, so the call returns before the export finishes. To create shifts with only clock-in and clock-out times, use `POST /rest/v2/time_tracking/shifts/raw`.

 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

schema.description: Request body for creating shifts

shifts.description: This is a sample shift description.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the employee contract.

external_id.description: External ID of the shift.

summary.description: Shift summary. The fields here form two mutually exclusive groups — hours-based (`shift_duration_hours`, `total_break_hours`, `payable_break_hours`, `total_payable_hours`) and unit-amount (`time_amount`, `time_unit`) — and the schema cannot express this as a strict either/or because which group is required depends on the shift rate (`shift_rate_external_id`) type, resolved server-side: PER_UNIT_FLAT_RATE requires the unit-amount group, PER_HOUR_FLAT_RATE requires the hours-based group, and MULTIPLIER_PERCENTAGE (or no shift rate) accepts either group but not a mix of both. Sending fields from both groups, or the wrong group for the rate type, is rejected.

payable_break_hours.description: Break hours that are payable. Part of the hours-based summary group (see `shift_duration_hours`).

shift_duration_hours.description: Total duration of the shift in hours. Lists the compliance documents the authenticated worker has to satisfy on one of their own contracts, together with what has already been submitted against each one. Use it to see what is still outstanding before payroll. Requirements with nothing submitted are included, with an empty `filenames` array and null timestamps. post.description:
Submit a new US tax form for the authenticated worker against a specific client legal entity, typically during onboarding or when a fresh form must be recorded for a worker/legal-entity pair. The worker is resolved from the access token; the target legal entity is set via client_legal_entity_id. Select the form type based on the worker's US tax status: W-9 for US individuals or entities, W-8BEN for non-US individuals, W-8BEN-E for non-US entities. The worker must have an active (non-terminated) contract with the legal entity, and only one tax form may exist per worker/legal-entity pair.

put.description:
This endpoint replaces/updates the authenticated worker's US tax form (W-8/W-9) with a corrected version, such as one that fixes a mistyped tax ID, legal name, or address.

The worker is identified from the access token, so ONLY their own forms can be replaced.

Send the complete form: any optional field you omit is cleared.

The exception is `contractor_signature`, which keeps the signature on file if you omit it and is required when the stored form has no signature.

`client_legal_entity_id` is not accepted, because the legal entity is part of the form's uniqueness key and can't be reassigned.

The worker must have an active (non-terminated) contract with the form's legal entity.

Please note: You can edit a tax form whose 1099 has already been filed with the IRS, but this operation does not refile the 1099 with the corrected form.

 **Token scopes**: `worker:write`
